prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Graphite and Aqua: page #F7FBFC, text #233338, accent #006C78, secondary surface #C9F0ED, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Work Sans; condensed heading with open sans text. Composition: Full-width relevant image with heading overlay, visible next section, no text/media split hero. Use body 20px, heading 28px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
